posts.author: Shepsie
posts.title: Merchant Flag
posts.html:
Me and couple of the other guys on ventrillo last night were brainstorming ideas and we came up with an idea to have some kind of merchant flag that could be issued too very good roleplayers who could roleplay (Sellers, Shops, Merchants) very well. The benefit of this flag if owned could maybe give a potential discount on shipments (5-10%) and maybe a reduced adverting fee of $30. The overall benefit of this will introduce more roleplay as these merchants can sell at competitive prices and it will tempt people into actually interacting with merchants opposed too (I need medkits BRB gotta go medic). I did think of two possible objections too this though, one being certain people who poses this flag will make money easier (Could be a reward of good roleplaying) and the other objection being it requires maintenance e.g. looking for good people etc.

Anyway that’s my idea, any constructive criticism is welcome.
